text.tspan: Figure 1. Delayed-onset design with color/motion swaps (Stoner and Blanc, 2010).

Stimuli are depicted as feature trajectories of dot fields. Dot fields are distinguished by line style (dashed vs solid) with color indicating actual color of dots. Motion type (clockwise, counter-clockwise, or translation) is given by vertical position. A) “Cued Translation”: delayed dots translate. B) “Uncued Translation”: non-delayed dots translate. C) “Uncued Translation”: non-delayed dots translate. B) “Cued Translation”: delayed dots translate. See Stoner and Blanc (2005) for further explanation.
Figure 1. Delayed-onset design with color/motion swaps (Stoner and Blanc, 2010).
Stimuli are depicted as feature trajectories of dot fields. Dot fields are distinguished by line style (dashed vs solid) with color
indicating actual color of dots. Motion type (clockwise, counter-clockwise, or translation) is given by vertical position.
A) “Cued Translation”: delayed dots translate. B) “Uncued Translation”: non-delayed dots translate. C) “Uncued Translation”:
non-delayed dots translate. B) “Cued Translation”: delayed dots translate. See Stoner and Blanc (2005) for further explanation.
